'''2000 Tatooine Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Tatooine region (Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00tatooine">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=tatooine 2000 Regionals: Tatooine], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010728170428/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=tatooine Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Josh Martin]] of Bakersfield, California won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Chapala's Mexican Restaurant Las Vegas, Nevada
